statements.impact_statement: The overflow is reachable only through zlib's gzprintf()/gzvprintf() after a stalled non-blocking gzwrite(). No ELF binary or shared library in the image imports gzprintf, gzvprintf, gzwrite, gzopen or gzdopen (nm -D scan of all ELF files at digest sha256:d1603c289cd8000cf1eab07f411a7630318a64368f56a93c2bf305cd09a4c68f on 2026-09-27). Alpine 3.24 and edge ship no zlib with the upstream 1.3.3 fix yet; remove this statement once the base carries it.

The flaw lets a client with a large max-stale read another user's security-zeroed entry from a SHARED HTTP cache. In this image the only copy is npm's bundled dependency (/usr/lib/node_modules/npm/node_modules/http-cache-semantics 4.2.0, sole copy at build on 2026-10-03), which backs npm's private client download cache for the single node user of one session's container; no process serves that cache to other users, and the requests in it are npm's own. check-http-cache-semantics.mjs fails the build if another copy appears. No fixed release exists (affected through 4.2.0); remove this statement once npm bundles a fixed version.
